title: Duke Ellington's Nutcracker Suite
description: A new Charlotte holiday tradition begins. This holiday season, experience Duke Ellingtons groundbreaking reimagining of The Nutcracker Suite performed live at the historic Carolina Theatre. Blending the timeless melodies of Tchaikovsky with the unmistakable brilliance, swing, and sophistication of American jazz, Ellingtons celebrated suite comes to life through a powerhouse jazz orchestra led by The Blackhawk Quintet. TiMar Entertainment proudly presents the beginning of what we hope will become one of Charlottes signature holiday traditions. The evening will feature acclaimed vocalist Dawn Anthony alongside an exceptional ensemble of Charlotte musicians, including Braxton Bateman, Harvey Cummings, Phillip Howe, Tim Scott, Jr. and Tyrone Jefferson, plus additional special guests. Together, they bring generations of Charlotte jazz, soul, and musical excellence to the stage for a one night only celebration of Duke Ellingtons enduring legacy.

title: Christmas Together with Amy Grant, Michael W. Smith, and CeCe Winans
description: Doors 6:00pm. Show 7:00pm. This Christmas season, three of music's most beloved voices - Amy Grant, CeCe Winans, and Michael W. Smith - come together for a one-of-a-kind evening of holiday music and celebration. Blending timeless Christmas classics with career-defining hits and moments of heartfelt worship, this special tour captures the warmth, joy, and spirit of the season. With decades of iconic songs and a shared legacy of faith, these three artists create an unforgettable night filled with nostalgia, joy, and powerful performances. Whether you're starting a new tradition or continuing a cherished one, this is a Christmas concert experience designed to bring people together and celebrate the hope, peace, and wonder of the season.

title: Rhythm & Roots: Soul Amplified
description: Experience an evening where R&B, soul, culture, legacy, and philanthropy come together. Rhythm & Roots returns for its second year with Soul Amplified, celebrating the impact and future of Black philanthropy through music and storytelling. Back by popular demand, Al Jasper & Friends return to the stage, followed by Gena Does Tina, a high-energy Tina Turner tribute led by powerhouse Carolina vocalist Gena Chambers. Celebrate Charlotte's Black philanthropic legacy as we honor the changemakers shaping the community. Proceeds support the Foundation For Black Philanthropy's grantmaking, programs, and continued investment in organizations serving Charlotte's Black community. VIP Ticket Upgrade: Elevate your Rhythm & Roots evening with early access to the exclusive Prelude Reception beginning at 5:30 p.m., featuring hors d'oeuvres, beer and wine, the Artist Corner live music experience, complimentary valet parking, and premium concert seating.
